wjq3xqw7.sourceDescription: Bring festive charm to your home with this green artificial Christmas tree, featuring 320 PVC branch tips for a lush, traditional appearance. Designed as a reusable alternative to a real tree, it has a durable metal frame and folding metal base to provide reliable support throughout the festive season. The tree comes in three hinged sections for straightforward assembly and convenient storage after use. Simply connect the sections, spread the branches and shape them to achieve the desired fullness. Suitable for seasonal decorating, this tree can be styled with your favourite baubles, tinsel and Christmas lights. Mains-operated Christmas lights are available separately and can be used indoors or outdoors, provided the transformer remains indoors. Specifications: Made from PVC with 320 branch tips, a durable metal frame and a folding metal base. Features three hinged sections for easy assembly and storage. Christmas lights are sold separately. 4w4pwav4.variantName: Walplus 300 LED Fairy Lights Pre-lit Artificial Christmas Tree - Green - 180 cm
4w4pwav4.sourceDescription: This Artificial Pre-lit Christmas Tree with LED Light brings the festive joy directly to your home or outside area. Its trendy cone shape is all about elegance and simplicity, making it the perfect focal point for your indoor or outdoor holiday decorations. With warm LED lights creating a lovely ambiance, this tree turns your living room, garden, or terrace into a festive wonderland while keeping things stylish and minimalist. Whether it’s for parties or quiet evenings in, its gentle glow and modern look will fit right in. Complete Set: The Artificial Pre-lit Christmas Tree comes with beautiful warm white LED decorative string lights that give you a heartwarming festive glow. These energy-efficient lights sparkle without the hassle of tangling wires, so you can set up quickly and easily. Durability and Style: Made with PVC, this tree is UV resistant, keeping its vibrant look during the holiday season even in the sun. The strong steel frame makes it sturdy while the modern, cone shape blends well with today’s home decor. Versatile Placement: Great for both indoor and outdoor use, this tree can be the star of your living room or add charm to your garden or terrace. Its good looks and practical design make it easy to fit into various settings, boosting the Christmas spirit wherever it goes. Efficient Power Options: With its USB-powered lights, this tree offers convenience by connecting to any power source with a standard 5V USB connector (not included). You can easily place the tree wherever it looks best. Assembly and Care: Two people are needed for assembly, just follow the manufacturer’s instructions to set it up without a hitch. Looking after your tree is a piece of cake, so it stays a treasured part of your holiday celebrations for years to come. Its attractive cone shape and warm LED lighting transform any space into a winter wonderland, creating a cozy atmosphere for families and guests. Materials: Constructed from high-quality PVC, this modern artificial Christmas tree provides a sense of real evergreen foliage without the maintenance of a live tree. The use of PVC ensures durability and a lifelike appearance that stays vibrant season after season. Its green hue complements any holiday decor with elegance. Included Components: Equipped with LED strip lights and a USB plug, this tree offers convenient, safe lighting. The LEDs emit a warm white glow, filling your space with an inviting ambiance. Easily adjustable, these lights let you craft the perfect atmosphere at your holiday gatherings. Decorative Features: This tree features simple yet striking decorations that enhance its sleek modern look. The decorative accents lend an air of elegance and sophistication, turning your living area or outdoor space into a holiday sanctuary. Recommended Uses: Ideal for various settings, from cozy living rooms to open terraces. Its compact yet prominent presence adapts beautifully to small spaces or as a centerpiece in larger rooms, offering flexibility in decorating styles. Care &Maintenance: For best results, cover the tree when not in use to protect from dust and debris. A certified 5V USB power source is required to operate the tree's LED lights, ensuring optimal performance throughout the holiday season.
